items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: I saw him down in Miami some, well, it was quite a number of years ago now.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, I did. I knew Eddie. I don't know whether they remember me. I remember Swoboda, too. No, was it Shabarra or Swoboda? The drummer? The drummer.

Sparbarro, yeah, that was it. Yeah. I saw him down in Miami some, well, it was quite a number of years ago now. He had an orchestra down there playing drums and had him advertised as a drummer with the original Dixieland Jazz Band, big sign out.
